title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: monotonicallyDecreasing
text:
monotonically decreasing
monotonically decreasing
(definition)
Definition:
A
function
from a
partially ordered
domain
to a partially ordered
range
such that x ≤ y implies f(x) ≥ f(y).
See also
monotonically increasing
,
strictly decreasing
.
Note:
After
[CLR90, page 32]
.

PEB
